stories.title: Demo: Local records raise questions over delayed civic works
stories.summary: A cluster of ward-level documents and resident reports points to repeated delays in a public works project that has received little national coverage.
stories.why_it_matters: The documents may reveal a gap between announced spending and visible delivery at neighbourhood level.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: Tender records establish the project scope; completion status still requires an on-site update.

stories.title: Demo: Rural clinic staffing concerns surface through district reporting
stories.summary: Local reporters and public staffing records describe recurring vacancies across several primary health centres.
stories.why_it_matters: Persistent vacancies can affect access to routine and emergency care without attracting sustained national attention.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: The latest duty roster has not been independently obtained.

stories.title: Demo: Contract workers document delayed payments at an industrial site
stories.summary: Worker testimonies, a union letter and company correspondence describe a dispute over several weeks of pending wages.
stories.why_it_matters: Delayed wages have immediate household effects, while labour disputes are often reported only after escalation.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: The company disputes the duration of the delay.
No labour department order is available yet.

stories.title: Demo: Residents challenge notice process in a land acquisition case
stories.summary: Residents, legal volunteers and a public notice provide differing accounts of whether affected households received adequate consultation.
stories.why_it_matters: Procedural gaps can determine whether communities are able to challenge displacement before construction begins.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

stories.title: Demo: Community videos prompt inquiry into a polluted river stretch
stories.summary: Geolocated public videos and local reporting show discoloured water downstream of an industrial cluster; the pollution source remains unconfirmed.
stories.why_it_matters: Early documentation can preserve evidence before formal sampling results are available.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: The date and exact source of discharge require verification.

stories.title: Demo: District women’s team seeks travel support after qualification
stories.summary: Players and coaches say a recently qualified district team lacks confirmed funding for travel to a national competition.
stories.why_it_matters: Grass-roots sports achievements and funding gaps often receive little attention outside the athletes’ home district.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: Competition registration has been confirmed; travel budget is not public.

stories.title: Demo: Panchayat meeting minutes contradict public timeline
stories.summary: Meeting minutes reviewed by a local outlet indicate that a sanitation project was postponed before the date cited in a later public statement.
stories.why_it_matters: Contradictory timelines may clarify responsibility for service delays.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

stories.title: Demo: Parents report prolonged classroom shortage after storm damage
stories.summary: Parent interviews, photographs and school correspondence describe classes being combined while repairs await approval.
stories.why_it_matters: Temporary arrangements can become long-term disruptions without regular public scrutiny.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: Repair approval status is based on a school letter, not the full department file.

stories.title: Demo: Small vendors contest relocation plan around transit project
stories.summary: Market vendors say the proposed relocation site would sharply reduce foot traffic; planners cite safety and congestion concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: Street-level economic effects can be obscured when infrastructure coverage focuses only on project completion.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: No independent footfall estimate is available for the proposed site.

stories.title: Demo: Family and police give different accounts of a short detention
stories.summary: A family statement, legal aid note and police diary entry disagree over the timing and grounds of a temporary detention.
stories.why_it_matters: Precise chronology is essential when evaluating due-process claims.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.

disagreements: Available documents do not establish the complete custody timeline.

stories.title: Demo: Informal workers map heat exposure around a wholesale market
stories.summary: A volunteer survey and temperature logs describe limited shade and drinking-water access during peak working hours.
stories.why_it_matters: Hyperlocal heat exposure data can reveal risks missed by city-wide averages.

confidence.rationale: The label reflects source independence, direct evidence, corroboration and unresolved contradictions in this demo record.
